EC1: - Acute illness in the preceding 6 weeks
EC3: - History of deep vein thrombosis [OR] or clotting disorders
EC6: - Any clinically significant findings at screening
EC9: - History of gastrointestinal motility disorders (e.g. gastroesophageal reflux disease -irritable bowel syndrome, [OR] gastroparesis, [OR] sphincter of Oddi dysfunction, etc.)
EC11: - Those who report having ≤3 bowel movements/week [OR] or >2/day.
